proof_scope: The run.sh front door: one line drives every debugger capability from any skill, agent, or human with zero env assembly -- headless breakpoint proof (break), live bridge stop (stop), narrated walkthrough (walkthrough), proof validation (validate), self-check (verify) -- and unknown subcommands fail closed with usage. The break subcommand puts the caller's cwd on PYTHONPATH so multi-module scenarios work from their own directory. Live cases are capability-gated on an open, trusted VS Code workspace with the bridge extension. Includes the foreign-cwd multi-module case: the in-process capture harness must put the script's own directory on sys.path like `python3 script.py` does.

claims.proves: run.sh break produces a validating debugger.proof.v1 with real hit locals from the scenario directory with no exported env; run.sh stop settles a live bridge pause and prints the runtime status path + terminal STATUS; run.sh walkthrough completes a 2-stop live tour; run.sh verify passes the deterministic self-check; run.sh validate accepts the canonical proof; and an unknown subcommand exits 2 with usage
claims.does_not_prove: the voice/two-model layers through the front door (owned by walkthrough-voice/voice-delivery/walkthrough-e2e), or matrix suite completeness (owned by run_eval_matrix receipts)

cases.name: break-headless-proof-no-env-assembly
cases.description: From the scenario directory, one line captures 5 hits at tally.py:12 with real locals and the produced proof passes independent validation.
command: set -euo pipefail; cd ../scenarios/variable_state; P=$(mktemp); ../../run.sh break tally.py:12 --local seen --local value --out "$P" -- python3 main.py >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert d['hit_count']==5, d['hit_count']; assert d['hits'][0]['locals']['seen']=='[1]', d['hits'][0]; print('BREAK-CAPTURED-5-HITS')" "$P"; ../../run.sh validate "$P" --expect-valid

cases.name: stop-live-one-liner
cases.description: One line with no exported env pauses the live debugger at a breakpoint and prints the settled status path; the paused local is read back from the receipt.
command: set -uo pipefail; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; [ -z "$WS" ] && { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; OUT=$(cd "$WS" && "$WS/skills/debugger/run.sh" stop "$WS/skills/debugger/scenarios/variable_state/main.py:20" --local first) || { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; echo "$OUT"; SP=$(echo "$OUT" | grep '^STATUS_PATH' | awk '{print $2}'); python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print('LOCAL-FIRST=', (d.get('stoppedState') or {}).get('locals',{}).get('first'))" "$SP"

cases.name: walkthrough-live-one-liner
cases.description: One line runs the 2-stop e2e walkthrough to completion through the front door.
command: set -uo pipefail; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; [ -z "$WS" ] && { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; (cd "$WS" && timeout 280 "$WS/skills/debugger/run.sh" walkthrough skills/debugger/scenarios/variable_state/walkthrough.e2e.json --commands 'continue;continue' --wait-seconds 60) | grep -E 'WALKTHROUGH-COMPLETE' || { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }

cases.name: verify-self-check
cases.description: ./run.sh verify runs the deterministic self-check (proof validator + containment guard + bridge protocol tests) and emits its receipt line.

cases.name: unknown-subcommand-fails-closed
cases.description: An unknown subcommand exits 2 and prints usage instead of guessing.
command: set -uo pipefail; ../run.sh frobnicate; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 2 ] && exit 0 || { echo "UNEXPECTED-RC=$rc"; exit 1; }

cases.name: break-multimodule-from-foreign-cwd
cases.description: run.sh break on a multi-module scenario invoked from a FOREIGN cwd (like the live-evidence lane does): the harness must put the script's own directory on sys.path, exactly as `python3 script.py` would, so sibling imports work and the breakpoint hits.
command: set -euo pipefail; SKILL="$(cd .. && pwd)"; T=$(mktemp -d); cd "$T"; P="$T/proof.json"; "$SKILL/run.sh" break "$SKILL/scenarios/variable_state/tally.py:12" --local seen --out "$P" -- python3 "$SKILL/scenarios/variable_state/main.py" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert d['hit_count']==5, d['hit_count']; print('FOREIGN-CWD-5-HITS')" "$P"; "$SKILL/run.sh" validate "$P" --expect-valid
